implementation.scope: Object field chain and virtual scale, preferred float field selection, flag-directed virtual tail routing and optional-field direct tail routing. Ordered ordinary RAM, selected GPR/FPR/CR6/FPSCR and guest-call boundaries are modeled.

validation.tested_scope: Virtual scale callback with live object mutation, three preferred-float branches, both flag-selected virtual tails and absent/present optional-field direct tails. Complete pinned caller bodies; mutable guest callbacks represent callee boundaries. Selected GPR/FPR/CR6/FP cache, x64 host control, ordered RAM and call events.
validation.unvalidated_scope: Callee internals including direct 822C5E58, signaling NaNs, subnormals, host exceptions, other inputs/aliasing, faults, MMIO, concurrency, unselected ABI/FP and runtime.
